> Dữ liệu mẫu cho demo, không phải người dùng thật. Lỗi này do người chạy demo **cài vào có chủ ý** (demo SDLC-4), xem commit gài bug.

- Người gửi: Vy (người dùng, gửi qua form góp ý)
- Ngày: 2026-10-29
- Lượt +1: 1

Mình có 4 việc, chưa xong việc nào. Bấm tab "Đã xong" thì app hiện "Chưa có việc nào. Nếu có file sao lưu, hãy bấm Nhập từ file".
Mình hết hồn tưởng mất hết, suýt bấm nhập file sao lưu cũ đè lên. Quay lại tab "Tất cả" thì 4 việc vẫn còn.

Base directory for this skill: <thư-mục-tạm> UX standard · v2

Sample standard for the demo. Each rule has an ID; cite it as `policy-ux@2#U<n>`.

- **U1.** Never lose the user's data silently. Any failed save is shown on the same screen, in plain words, with what the user can do
  next.
- **U2.** No confirmation dialogs for actions on a single item: they happen at once and offer **Undo** for 10 seconds instead.
  Actions that overwrite or delete more than one item follow `policy-security#S2` (confirm first). *(Changed in v2, agreed by the UX
  and security owners, 2026-10-20.)*
- **U3.** Every list or screen defines its empty, loading and error states.
- **U4.** UI text is Vietnamese, short, and free of technical words (no "localStorage", "JSON", "console").
- **U5.** Every control works with the keyboard and has an accessible label.

content.text:
I fixed the bug Vy reported (ticket T-014). A filter tab with nothing in it no longer shows the "import a backup" hint while the list still has todos.

**Size: Small.** One bug, in one place.

**Cause:** in `app/app.js`, the empty-list message only checked whether the current tab (filter) showed any todos. It never checked whether the whole list was empty. So with 4 open todos, the "Đã xong" tab counted as empty and showed "Chưa có việc nào… Nhập từ file", which nearly led Vy to import an old backup over her list.

**Fix:**
- `app/app.js`: the import hint (`MESSAGES.emptyList`) now shows only when the whole list is empty. If only the current tab is empty, the app says which tab:
  - "Đã xong": **"Chưa có việc nào đã xong."**
  - "Chưa xong": **"Không còn việc nào chưa xong."**
- `app/backup.js`: those two sentences are added to `MESSAGES`, next to `emptyList`.

**Test first:** `tests/empty-filter.test.js` (new, 3 tests). Before the fix, the two tab tests failed for the right reason: the app showed `emptyList` where `emptyDone`/`emptyOpen` was expected. The third test confirms the hint still appears on every tab when the list really is empty. I added a new file rather than editing `tests/app.test.js`, so no committed test was changed.

```
ℹ tests 45
ℹ pass 45
ℹ fail 0
== check: OK
```

That is 42 existing tests plus 3 new ones.

**Other notes:**
- The two new sentences are my own wording. A person may want to adjust them.
- The other planted bug, **T-013**, is still there and I left it alone because you didn't ask for it. On the "Đã xong" tab, the count line still says "0 việc chưa xong", because it counts only the todos on the current tab (`app/app.js:51`).
- Nothing is committed. The change and the new test are in the working tree for you to review and commit.
